detailZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛：乔治·拉塞尔在巴库一练中最快，基米·安东内利遭遇液压泄漏
乔治·拉塞尔在阿塞拜疆大奖赛开局强劲，在首次练习赛中排名第一，而他的梅赛德斯队友基米·安东内利则遭遇可靠性问题；巴库第二次练习赛将于周四下午1点播出，排位赛将于周五下午1点播出，均在天空体育 F1直播
基米·安东内利因梅赛德斯赛车液压故障提前结束首次练习赛
乔治·拉塞尔在阿塞拜疆大奖赛首次练习赛中最快，而积分榜领先者基米·安东内利因液压问题停在赛道上。
拉塞尔在车手积分榜上落后安东内利81分，必须尽快缩小与队友的差距，以避免F1冠军争夺过早失去悬念，而他在巴库的这场比赛开局强劲。
这位梅赛德斯车手在最快圈中借助费尔南多·阿隆索的巨大尾流，以0.4秒优势击败红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘和两辆法拉利，但在本节早些时候也展现了极快的速度。

安东内利因液压问题被迫停车，损失了35分钟的赛道时间，因此他将在周四下午1点（天空体育 F1直播）的第二次练习赛前处于劣势。
这位意大利车手赢得了最近两场比赛，但巴库是赛历上最艰难的赛道之一，经常出现戏剧性场面，因此安东内利警惕自己对拉塞尔的81分领先优势以及对刘易斯·汉密尔顿和兰多·诺里斯的100多分优势可能迅速被缩小。
“就基米的练习赛而言，FP1是最不具代表性的练习赛，所以这算是幸运，”天空体育 F1的杰米·查德威克说。
“更大的担忧是他们为什么会出现这个问题。我们知道可靠性在本节早些时候是梅赛德斯的一大话题；最近几场比赛似乎情况好多了，但这将是最令人担忧的。”
克雷格·斯莱特解析阿塞拜疆大奖赛，包括为什么比赛在周六举行，同时尽力模仿克雷格·大卫！
汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔用中性胎做出最快圈速，因此他们希望能在周五排位赛中争夺杆位，并在周六下午的正赛中获胜。
红牛为巴库带来了一些新部件，包括修改后的底板、侧箱和后视镜，维斯塔潘在练习赛早期使用硬胎时看起来非常快。
去掉拉塞尔最快圈中的尾流，红牛似乎在前方与梅赛德斯和法拉利展开竞争。
迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里和兰多·诺里斯分别排名第六和第14，尽管赛车有升级，但仍落后拉塞尔超过一秒。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿表示，他相信车队可以取得进步，因为他正在努力追求“更干净”的比赛周末
迈凯伦的升级主要是空气动力学改动，这将在高速非街道赛道上更有利，他们在剩余两节练习赛中还有大量时间可以挖掘。
皮亚斯特里一度以为赛车有损伤，但车队告诉他他们看不到任何问题，而诺里斯尚未展现真正速度。
伊萨克·哈贾尔——已宣布将在2027年留在红牛——因手腕伤势缺席了最近三个比赛周末，自7月以来首次回归，但因引擎问题损失了30分钟的练习时间。
威廉姆斯的卡洛斯·塞恩斯在阿塞拜疆大奖赛练习中因刹车起火被迫进站
这意味着利亚姆·劳森回到小红牛，他迅速进入状态排名第七，队友阿尔维德·林德布拉德排名第八。
埃斯特班·奥康——由于哈斯预计将放弃他，明年可能没有F1席位——排名第九，奥迪的加布里埃尔·博托莱托排名第十。
威廉姆斯的卡洛斯·塞恩斯早些时候遭遇轻微刹车起火，但在这个车队带来重大升级包的周末，这几乎没有让他损失赛道时间。

detailEn: Azerbaijan GP: George Russell fastest as Kimi Antonelli suffers hydraulics leak in Baku first practice

George Russell made a strong start to the Azerbaijan Grand Prix by topping first practice as his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli had reliability woes; watch second practice in Baku later on Thursday at 1pm, with Qualifying on Friday also at 1pm, live on Sky Sports F1
Kimi Antonelli ends his first practice session early after a hydraulics failure on his Mercedes
George Russell was fastest in first practice at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix as championship leader Kimi Antonelli stopped on track with a hydraulics issue.

Russell is 81 points behind Antonelli in the Drivers' Championship and must start gaining ground on his team-mate soon to avoid an early conclusion to the Formula 1 title race and he's started the event in Baku strongly.

The Mercedes driver was helped by a big slipstream from Fernando Alonso on his best lap to outpace Red Bull's Max Verstappen and both Ferraris by four tenths but showed great speed earlier in the session too.

Antonelli lost 35 minutes of track time after a hydraulics issue forced him to stop, so he will be on the back foot heading into second practice later on Thursday at 1pm, live on Sky Sports F1.

The Italian has won the last two races but Baku is one of the toughest tracks on the calendar and often throws up drama, so Antonelli is wary of how his 81-point lead over Russell and 100+ points advantage to Lewis Hamilton and Lando Norris could quickly be cut.
"In terms of Kimi's session, FP1 is the least representative session, so that's a blessing," said Sky Sports F1's Jamie Chadwick.

"The bigger concern is why they had the issue. We knew reliability was a big talking point for Mercedes earlier in the session; it seems to have been in a much better place the last few races especially, but that's going to be the biggest concern."
Craig Slater breaks down the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, including why the race takes place on a Saturday, while doing his best Craig David impression!
Hamilton and Charles Leclerc set their best times on the mediums, so will be hoping to be in contention for pole in Qualifying on Friday and the win in the race itself on Saturday afternoon.
Red Bull have brought some new parts to Baku including a revised floor, sidepod and mirrors and Verstappen looked very quick on the hard tyres early in the session.
Take away Russell's slipstream on his best lap and Red Bull appear to be in the fight at the front with Mercedes and Ferrari.
McLaren's Oscar Piastri and Lando Norris were sixth and 14th, over one second behind Russell despite having upgrades on their car.
Lewis Hamilton says he believes the team can make improvements as he strives for 'cleaner' weekends
McLaren's developments are mainly aerodynamic changes which will be more beneficial on high-speed non-street tracks and they have lots of time to find in the remaining two practice sessions.
At one point, Piastri thought he had damage on the car but the team told him there was nothing they could see, while Norris is yet to show his true pace.

Isack Hadjar, who was announced to stay at Red Bull for 2027, is back for the first time since July after missing the last three race weekends due to a wrist injury but lost 30 minutes of running due to an engine problem.
Williams' Carlos Sainz was forced to enter pits after a fire on his brakes during practice at Azerbaijan GP
That means Liam Lawson returns to Racing Bulls and he has flown out of the blocks in seventh with team-mate Arvid Lindblad in eighth.
Esteban Ocon, who is set to be left without an F1 seat next year as Haas are expected to drop him, was ninth and Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto was 10th.
Williams' Carlos Sainz suffered a minor brakes fire early on, but it cost him little track time on a weekend the team have brought a significant upgrade package.

detailEn: Qatar GP Qualifying: George Russell bounces back with superb performance to beat Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli to pole position

George Russell beats Kimi Antonelli to pole as Mercedes seal dominant one-two; Lando Norris ahead of Oscar Piastri on second row; Isack Hadjar beats Max Verstappen to fifth; watch the Qatar Grand Prix live on Sky Sports F1 at 4pm on Sunday, with build-up from 2.30pm
George Russell took pole position in Qatar as Kimi Antonelli seemed unhappy with his lap during qualifying
George Russell produced a superb performance in Qatar Grand Prix Qualifying to beat his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli to pole position.

The reignition of Russell's feud with Max Verstappen at last weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix had dominated the build-up to the penultimate race of the season, but the Brit produced the perfect response as he topped all three parts of qualifying.

That came as a surprise after Antonelli, who sealed the drivers' title with four rounds to spare, had topped all three practice sessions, but the Italian was unable to match Russell when it mattered most.

McLaren found significant improvement on the final runs to move ahead of Red Bull as Mercedes' nearest challenger and lock out the second row, with Lando Norris ahead of Oscar Piastri as the best of the rest despite being marginally either side of half a second down on Russell.
Verstappen, who said after winning in Las Vegas last weekend that Russell is "far below" his level, was beaten to fifth by his Red Bull team-mate Isack Hadjar.
Charles Leclerc took seventh but his Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton was beaten to eighth by Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad, with the latter's team-mate Liam Lawson completing the top ten.

汉密尔顿在整个练习赛中都很不高兴，并在他的最后一圈飞驰后表示他的“赛车无法转向”，这使他排在第九位，位于小红牛车队的Arvid Lindblad和劳森之间。

detailEn: Qatar GP: Kimi Antonelli fastest in final practice from George Russell as Mercedes domination continues ahead of qualifying

Kimi Antonelli led George Russell in another Mercedes one-two in final practice at the Lusail International Circuit; watch Qualifying at 6pm later on Saturday and the Qatar Grand Prix at 4pm on Sunday, live on Sky Sports F1

George Russell says Lewis Hamilton is an equally 'ruthless competitor' to Max Verstappen but that his former team-mate has 'incredible values, grace and dignity'. Watch the full interview during Sky Sports F1's live Qatar GP coverage on Sunday
Kimi Antonelli outpaced Mercedes team-mate George Russell in final practice for the Qatar Grand Prix as the Silver Arrows continued to dominate.

Antonelli, who topped both of Friday's practice sessions, outpaced Russell by 0.249s and it looks highly likely a Mercedes driver will be on pole position after qualifying, which takes place later on Saturday at 6pm (build-up from 5.15pm), live on Sky Sports F1.
Mercedes appear to have a half-second advantage over the rest field as Max Verstappen was 0.510s adrift of Antonelli and the other Red Bull of Isack Hadjar was 0.687s behind.

Mercedes' dominance is a surprise as nearly every race following August's summer break has been very competitive at the front but it seems a combination of the smooth, high-speed track layout and Mercedes finally getting on top of their upgrades from a month ago has given them a significant margin on their rivals.
"Mercedes are almost in a class of their own, so it's worth the rest looking at the gap to Verstappen [in third]," said Sky Sports F1's Bernie Collins.

Ferrari had a difficult Friday after a spin for Charles Leclerc and an engine issue for Lewis Hamilton, but Leclerc fared better in final practice in fifth, ahead of McLaren's Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri.
Hamilton was unhappy throughout the session and stated his "car won't turn" after his final flying lap which put him in ninth, in between Racing Bulls duo Arvid Lindblad and Liam Lawson.
